question: In which kinds of difficult situations is the prescribed oblation applicable?
premises: Difficult but achievable situations are included.
Extreme difficulties and divinely achievable matters are included.
inference: The oblation applies in difficulties ranging from achievable to extreme, divinely achievable, and even unachievable situations.
plain_english: In difficulties that are achievable, in extreme difficulties, in matters achievable only by divine means, and even in the unachievable—
